items.title: Save, Search & Organize Links
items.description: Save links via Share sheet, text-selection pill, Clipboard detection, or in-app sheet with offline Room search, filters, and layouts.
preconditions: Non-empty URL or link query
Network access only when refreshing remote link metadata
sideEffects: Writes saved link records and enriched metadata into local Room storage

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Link is saved locally offline, but remote preview metadata could not be fetched.
Social media link resolution is offline or rate-limited; basic URL saving still succeeds.

items.title: Unified Collections
items.description: Create, rename, and delete custom collections holding both saved links and Movies & TV titles.
preconditions: Target collection name or existing collection ID
sideEffects: Updates local Room collection memberships for saved links or Movies & TV titles

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: The requested collection does not exist yet; open Collections to create or select one.

items.title: Media Downloader & Offline Library
items.description: Inspect and download video/audio formats on-device with Queue and Library tabs plus optional folder export.
preconditions: Initialized yt-dlp runtime for extraction
Network connectivity for remote media inspection or download
sideEffects: Downloads media files to device storage
Deleting a download permanently removes the local file

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: On-device media extractor failed to initialize; retry extraction or check Media & Downloads settings.
On-device extraction still runs for supported URLs, while backend social link resolvers are paused.

items.title: YouTube Captions & Transcript Export
items.description: Extract available YouTube captions for videos or playlists without downloading video/audio, copy to clipboard, and export Markdown (.md), Plain Text (.txt), or PDF (.pdf).
items.conditionNote: Requires accessible caption tracks on the YouTube video or playlist; local Whisper speech transcription is not built in.
preconditions: Valid YouTube video or playlist URL
Accessible YouTube caption tracks on the target video
sideEffects: Saves extracted Markdown, Plain Text, or PDF transcript documents to Downloads Library

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: This video has no accessible YouTube captions; Laterbox does not perform local Whisper speech transcription.
On-device extractor hit an error; watch-page caption fallback is attempted when available.

items.title: Automatic Folder Export
items.description: Export downloaded media or transcript documents to a user-selected Android folder.
items.conditionNote: Requires granting access to an export folder in Settings.
preconditions: User-granted Storage Access Framework (SAF) directory URI
Target folder remains writable
sideEffects: Copies exported media or transcript documents into the user-selected Android folder

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: No SAF export folder is selected; choose one in Media & Downloads settings.
Android folder permission expired or the folder moved; re-select the export folder.

items.title: Movies & TV Discovery and Library
items.description: Browse curated rails, search catalogue providers, manage Watchlist, Continue Watching, Collections, and watch history.
preconditions: Remote feature movies_tv_enabled is active
At least one online catalogue provider enabled for remote search
sideEffects: Updates local watchlist, watch history, and episode progress in Room

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Movies & TV is turned off in Remote Configuration or app settings.
Online catalogue search and streaming are paused during maintenance; local watchlist, history, and offline downloads remain usable.
One or more online catalogue providers are disabled; remaining active providers and local library still work.

items.title: Personalized Recommendations & Surprise Me
items.description: Shows Picked For You, content-aware Because You Watched & More Like This, Surprise Me, and Like/Dislike feedback powered by always-on local Experience Intelligence.
preconditions: Remote feature movies_recommendations_enabled is active
On-device Experience Intelligence learns continuously from likes, dislikes, watch completions, collections, reminders, and searches
sideEffects: Computes discovery rails locally in Room from behavioral signals, feedback, and content understanding

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Personalized recommendations are currently disabled in Remote Configuration.

items.title: Picture-in-Picture & Mini-Player
items.description: Pressing Home or Back during active playback enters system Picture-in-Picture; pressing Back after pausing playback returns to Laterbox with its in-app mini-player.
preconditions: App version build 62+
Movies & TV enabled
Active or paused video playback session
sideEffects: Transitions player into system Picture-in-Picture or in-app mini-player overlay

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Picture-in-Picture is disabled in Android system app settings; paused playback still falls back to the in-app mini-player.

items.title: Skip Intro & Skip Recap
items.description: Shows skip buttons in the player when verified timestamps exist in source metadata.
items.conditionNote: Appears only when verified intro or recap timestamps are provided by the stream source.
preconditions: Remote feature player_intro_skip_enabled is active
Verified intro or recap timestamps provided in episode metadata
sideEffects: Seeks active playback to the verified end timestamp when tapped

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Skip Intro and Skip Recap only appear when verified timestamps exist in source metadata.

items.title: Share Titles & Downloaded Files
items.description: Share Movie or TV Series links directly to Laterbox web/app links, and share generic downloaded files safely via Android FileProvider (individual downloaded episodes share the series link instead).
preconditions: App version build 62+
Target title ID or local downloaded file
sideEffects: Invokes Android share sheet with a Laterbox deep link or FileProvider URI

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Downloaded file could not be found on disk; share the title link or re-download instead.

items.title: Scheduled & Smart Reminders
items.description: Per-link reminders, Movies & TV viewing alerts, Quiet Hours, and notification history.
preconditions: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+
Smart Reminders enabled for proactive nudges
sideEffects: Schedules local AlarmManager reminder broadcasts and posts local notifications

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Notifications are disabled in Android system settings.
Exact alarms are restricted; Laterbox falls back to a flexible reminder window.

items.title: Laterbox Assistant & Actions
items.description: Streaming Q&A, live web search grounding for outside facts, and permission-aware in-app actions.
preconditions: Remote feature ai_assistant_enabled is active
Assistant enabled in Reminders & AI settings
Authenticated backend session or user Gemini key
sideEffects: Sends bounded prompt context to backend AI
Mutating actions update local state or delete conversation history when confirmed

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: Laterbox Assistant is disabled in settings or Remote Configuration.
Assistant AI streaming is temporarily paused during online maintenance.

items.title: Archived Links
items.description: Store finished links out of the active Inbox with search and one-tap restore.
preconditions: At least one archived link in local Room storage
sideEffects: Moves links between Inbox and Archive in local Room storage

failureRecoveryPaths.explanation: No archived links exist yet; archive read items from Inbox to store them here.
